summary.text: Brad Hudson is a Republican member of the Missouri Senate for District 33 in southern Missouri, first elected in 2024 and sworn in on January 8, 2025.

His official Senate page says he previously served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2019 to 2025 and lists him as vice-chair of the Appropriations and Education committees and chair of the Select Committee on Government Modernization Transformation.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography says Hudson is the pastor at Blessing Heights Worship Center and served as Stone County Assessor from 2009 to 2018.
It lists a bachelor's degree in Biblical Studies from the Midwest College of Theology in 2011, and says he grew up on a small family farm near Cape Fair, where he still lives with his wife, Carissa.
